description: Create src/store.ts as the fully typed TypeScript twin of the untyped src/store.js key/value cache - Entry and StoreOptions interfaces, generics where they earn their keep, strict-mode-clean signatures with no any - while src/store.js stays untouched as the behavioural reference; needles prove the typed surface exists and the any type is gone.

criteria: src/store.ts exists as a strict-mode-clean TypeScript port of the store - an Entry interface for the stored records, a StoreOptions interface for construction options, a generic Store class with fully typed methods and no any anywhere - whose runtime behavior for TTL semantics, insertion order, eviction and return values matches src/store.js, and src/store.js itself is byte-for-byte untouched.
